name: WholeStack WF-038: Buyer Matching & Buy-Box Ranking

parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const req=input.disposition_match_request||input; const p=req.property_identity||{}; const buyers=Array.isArray(input.buyers)?input.buyers:Array.isArray(input.buyer_records)?input.buyer_records:[]; const num=v=>{const n=Number(v);return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null}; const price=num(req.assignment_price??req.disposition_price??req.contract?.contract_price); const arv=num(req.financials?.arv??input.arv); const repairs=num(req.financials?.repairs??input.repairs??input.repair_estimate); const propertyType=String(input.property_type??req.property_type??\"\").toLowerCase().trim(); const city=String(input.city??p.city??\"\").toLowerCase().trim(); const state=String(input.state??p.state??\"\").toLowerCase().trim(); const zip=String(input.zip??p.zip??\"\").trim(); const strategy=String(req.disposition_strategy??input.disposition_strategy??\"\").toLowerCase().trim(); const matches=[]; for(const b of buyers){const maxPrice=num(b.max_price??b.max_purchase_price??b.buy_box?.max_price); const minPrice=num(b.min_price??b.min_purchase_price??b.buy_box?.min_price); const types=Array.isArray(b.property_types)?b.property_types.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):Array.isArray(b.buy_box?.property_types)?b.buy_box.property_types.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):[]; const cities=Array.isArray(b.cities)?b.cities.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):Array.isArray(b.buy_box?.cities)?b.buy_box.cities.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):[]; const states=Array.isArray(b.states)?b.states.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):Array.isArray(b.buy_box?.states)?b.buy_box.states.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):[]; const zips=Array.isArray(b.zips)?b.zips.map(String):Array.isArray(b.buy_box?.zips)?b.buy_box.zips.map(String):[]; const strategies=Array.isArray(b.strategies)?b.strategies.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):Array.isArray(b.buy_box?.strategies)?b.buy_box.strategies.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()):[]; let score=0; const reasons=[]; const misses=[]; if(price!==null&&maxPrice!==null){if(price<=maxPrice){score+=25;reasons.push(\"price_within_max\")}else misses.push(\"price_above_max\")}else misses.push(\"price_limit_unverified\"); if(price!==null&&minPrice!==null&&price>=minPrice){score+=5;reasons.push(\"price_above_min\")} if(propertyType&&types.length){if(types.includes(propertyType)){score+=20;reasons.push(\"property_type_match\")}else misses.push(\"property_type_mismatch\")}else score+=5; if(city&&cities.length){if(cities.includes(city)){score+=15;reasons.push(\"city_match\")}else misses.push(\"city_mismatch\")}else if(state&&states.length){if(states.includes(state)){score+=12;reasons.push(\"state_match\")}else misses.push(\"state_mismatch\")}else score+=3; if(zip&&zips.length){if(zips.includes(zip)){score+=15;reasons.push(\"zip_match\")}else misses.push(\"zip_mismatch\")} if(strategy&&strategies.length){if(strategies.includes(strategy)){score+=10;reasons.push(\"strategy_match\")}else misses.push(\"strategy_mismatch\")} if(arv!==null&&repairs!==null&&price!==null){const spread=arv-repairs-price; if(spread>0){score+=10;reasons.push(\"positive_estimated_spread\")}else misses.push(\"nonpositive_estimated_spread\")} const status=misses.includes(\"price_above_max\")||misses.includes(\"property_type_mismatch\")||misses.includes(\"city_mismatch\")||misses.includes(\"state_mismatch\")||misses.includes(\"zip_mismatch\")||misses.includes(\"strategy_mismatch\")?\"not_a_match\":score>=70?\"strong_match\":score>=50?\"possible_match\":\"needs_review\"; matches.push({buyer_id:b.buyer_id||b.id||b.external_id||null,buyer_name:b.name||b.buyer_name||null,score,status,reasons,missing_or_conflicting_criteria:misses,buy_box:b.buy_box||null,contact:{phone:b.phone||null,email:b.email||null}}); } matches.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score); const ready=Boolean(req.buyer_match_status===\"ready_for_buyer_matching\"||input.disposition_readiness?.buyer_matching_ready); return [{json:{...input,buyer_matching:{ready,property_identity:p,criteria:{price,arv,repairs,property_type:propertyType||null,city:city||null,state:state||null,zip:zip||null,strategy:strategy||null},buyer_count:buyers.length,matched_count:matches.filter(x=>x.status!==\"not_a_match\").length,top_matches:matches.slice(0,10),ranking_method:\"deterministic_buy_box_score\",outreach_authorized:false,next_action:ready?(matches.length?\"review_top_matches\":\"source_buyer_records\"):\"complete_disposition_readiness\"}}}];
